Usage: astryx integration add [options] <kind> <name>

Add one working contribution to an integration package

Arguments:
  kind                  component, doc, template, codemod, agent-doc, or theme
  name                  Contribution name: PascalCase for component (AcmeWidget); lowercase kebab-case for template, codemod, and theme (account-card); letters, digits, _ and - for doc; the literal guidance line for agent-doc

Options:
  --dry-run             Validate and show planned writes without changing files
  --type <type>         Template type: page (default) or block; only valid for template
  --replaces <topic>    Existing doc topic this one replaces (letters, digits, _ and -); only valid for doc and not with --extends
  --extends <topic>     Existing doc topic this one extends (letters, digits, _ and -); only valid for doc and not with --replaces
  --parent <namespace>  Namespace of this package to place the doc in, as a guide in its `guides` slot; writes the namespace doc when it is missing, and declares the CLI that reads it as an optional `@astryxdesign/cli` peer. Only valid for doc, and not with --replaces or --extends
  --from <theme>        Existing theme slug to fork as a starting point instead of a blank scaffold; the new theme copies the base and has no link back, and package.json `dependencies` gains the npm packages the copied files import (other than Core and React). Only valid for theme
  --to <version>        Exact semver of the @astryxdesign/core version whose upgrade runs the codemod (e.g. 0.7.0); required for codemod and only valid there
  -h, --help            display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  the contribution is written or the dry run succeeds
  1  the kind, name, options, package, or target files are invalid or conflict

Examples:
  # Preview
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 integration add component AcmeWidget --dry-run --json
  # Add a component
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 integration add component AcmeWidget
  # Add a doc topic
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 integration add doc deploying
  # Add a page template
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 integration add template acme-dashboard
  # Add a block template
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 integration add template account-card --type block
  # Replace a doc topic
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 integration add doc acme-getting-started --replaces getting-started
  # Extend a doc topic
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 integration add doc acme-theming --extends theme
  # Add a guide to the package's own docs section
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 integration add doc releasing --parent acme
  # Add a codemod
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 integration add codemod rename-widget --to 1.2.0
  # Add agent guidance
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 integration add agent-doc 'Run acme verify before finishing.'
  # Add a source theme
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 integration add theme ocean
  # Fork an existing theme
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 integration add theme ocean --from neutral

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/integration-add
